doctrine: This manifest is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for every scheduled invocation in the account.

To add, change or remove a schedule: edit this file, upload it to s3://justhodl-dashboard-live/config/schedule-manifest.json, then run the reconciler in enforce mode. Do NOT call put_rule from ops scripts — that is how 90 double-fire targets and a five-way duplicate accumulated.
Mode lives in SSM /justhodl/schedules/mode (audit|enforce) and takes effect without a redeploy.
Enforcement DISABLES undeclared rules; it never deletes.
